title: garival.com
description: The SQL script for monthly e-pay processing explicitly states: “Fake a autoload TR so the order will be fulfilled”. A neighboring script identifies orders without transaction usage, sets the fulfillment time, rc = 1, status = 1, and decrements loadseq. Other scripts include the GFIDBA role with ALL PRIVILEGES ... WITH ADMIN OPTION, unlocked accounts with trivial passwords, public read access to security tables, and dynamic deletion of backup tables via EXEC. The eight exports out1.csv–out8.csv contain 12,911 rows with card/order/fare fields. The banking records contain numerous discrepancies:
